title: Beyond Copying: Lifelong Smart Contract Security Task Construction via Protocol Mutation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents can inspect code and run tests to support smart contract security. SlowMist reports about $38.6 billion in losses across the broader blockchain ecosystem. Existing evaluations can reward memorized or copied answers, including attack code recovered from public blockchain transactions. Reconstructing contracts and validating tasks also require costly manual effort. To address these issues, we propose CONSTRAINTDIAL, a framework for lifelong construction of smart contract security tasks via protocol mutation. It automates local contract reconstruction and uses attack execution to select changes to the required calls or inputs. Execution checks guide revisions that make the original attack fail while preserving exploitability, the security objective, and normal functionality. translated_title: 超越复制：基于协议变异的智能合约安全任务终身构建
translated_abstract: AI智能体可以通过检查代码和运行测试来支持智能合约安全。据慢雾（SlowMist）统计，整个区块链生态系统的损失约为386亿美元。现有评估可能会奖励记忆或复制的答案，包括从公开区块链交易中恢复的攻击代码。此外，重构合约和验证任务也需要昂贵的人工投入。为解决这些问题，我们提出了CONSTRAINTDIAL，一个通过协议变异实现智能合约安全任务终身构建的框架。它自动化本地合约的重构过程，并利用攻击执行来选择对所需调用或输入的修改。执行检查指导修订，使原始攻击失败，同时保持可利用性、安全目标和正常功能。新发生的安全事件和审计发现也进入相同的流程。借助CONSTRAINTDIAL，我们从203个公开案例中构建了3,045个任务输入，涵盖检测、利用等（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出CONSTRAINTDIAL框架，通过协议变异自动修改智能合约的调用与输入，使原始攻击失效的同时保持可利用性和正常功能，从而实现安全任务的终身构建，从203个公开案例生成了3,045个任务输入，避免评估奖励记忆或复制的答案。
en_tdlr: We propose CONSTRAINTDIAL, a framework for lifelong smart contract security task construction via protocol mutation, which automatically modifies required calls and inputs so that original attacks fail while preserving exploitability and normal functionality, generating 3,045 task inputs from 203 public cases and preventing evaluations from rewarding memorized or copied answers.
